clips.title: The story
paras: While paying her regular respects at Ironbeard's Tomb, Sida was startled by the foul oozes prowling the barrows and threw her bag to distract them. Unable to face the creeping sludge again, she asks brave adventurers in Menethil Harbor to track down the creature that swallowed her belongings.

Sida, a traveler residing in Menethil Harbor, regularly ventures northeast into the Wetlands to pay homage at Ironbeard's Tomb. On her latest visit, she found the ancient barrow crawling with foul, dripping oozes. Panicking at the sight of the shapeless horrors, she hurled her satchel at one of them. The creature simply engulfed the bag whole, though the distraction gave Sida just enough time to flee back to the safety of the port town.

The burial site of the storied dwarven hero Ironbeard rests near the contested stronghold of Dun Modr. Despite its historical reverence, the surrounding marshland is prone to corruption, drawing amorphous acidic slimes that consume anything unfortunate enough to cross their path. Sida cannot remember which specific monstrosity swallowed her prized belongings, leaving travelers to scour the tomb grounds and carve through the creeping blight to recover her drenched satchel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.
I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.
The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!
I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, thank you, friend! I was afraid that it was lost for good!
She quickly empties the contents of the ooze-covered bag onto the ground, before scooping them up.
Hm, I don't have much use for this anymore, but wash it off and I'm sure you could make use of it.
